subtitle: Items, crews, reference lists and requests for new categories.

loadError.title: Could not load
loadError.text: Check the connection and retry. Nothing is lost.

unavailable.title: ERP is unavailable
unavailable.text: This section shows ERP data. Retry in a minute.

forbidden.title: This section is not for your role

errors.FORBIDDEN: This action is not allowed for your role.
errors.ERP_FORBIDDEN: ERP refused: you need the right to manage the catalogue or partners.
errors.SUPPLIER_PRICES_REQUIRED: Partner prices can only be changed by those who can see them (supply, director).
errors.CREW_RATES_REQUIRED: Crew rates can only be changed by the chief engineer, supply or the director.
errors.CONFLICT: This record already exists. Refresh the list.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The record is gone. Refresh the list.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: ERP did not answer. Retry in a minute.

reason.vat_rate_invalid: VAT is a number from 0 to 100, or empty.
reason.offer_price_invalid: Price is a number not below zero, up to two decimals.
reason.offer_validity_range_invalid: “Valid until” cannot be earlier than “Valid from”.
reason.brigade_name_required: Enter the crew or performer name.
reason.brigade_headcount_invalid: Headcount is a number from 1 to 500.
reason.rate_unit_invalid: Choose per day or per hour.
reason.crew_rate_invalid: The rate is a number not below zero.
reason.hs_code_invalid: An HS code has 2, 4, 6, 8 or 10 digits.
reason.hs_validity_range_invalid: “Valid until” cannot be earlier than “valid from”.
reason.hs_code_exists: This HS code is already in the list.
reason.manufacturer_exists: This manufacturer is already in the list.
reason.already_pending: A request for this category is already pending.
reason.file_too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
reason.file_type_not_allowed: PDF, PNG, JPEG, Word and Excel files are accepted.
reason.file_content_mismatch: The file content does not match its extension.
reason.tech_doc_link_required: Link the file to an item or to a request.
reason.multipart_required: Send the file as a form.
reason.already_reviewed: The request is already decided. Refresh the list.
reason.supplier_exists: This partner already exists: find it in the list.
reason.offer_exists: This partner already has a price for the item — edit it.
reason.proposal_decided: The change is already decided. Refresh the card.
reason.proposal_stale: The value is no longer in the reference. Reject the change.
reason.product_incomplete: Fill in the missing fields, then publish.
reason.supplier_id_required: Enter a TIN or a foreign registration number.
reason.supplier_not_found: Choose a partner or manufacturer from the list.
reason.supplier_invalid: Choose a partner from the list.
reason.rows_token_invalid: The check is out of date. Press “Check” again.
reason.contact_exists: The company already has a contact with this address.
reason.contact_email_ambiguous: This address is already used by a contact of another cabinet company. Use a different address.
reason.email_delivery_failed: The e-mail was not sent. Check the mail service and try again — access is unchanged.
reason.module_not_allowed: This section cannot be enabled for a partner.
reason.image_main_required: Change the main photo by choosing another photo.
reason.image_order_invalid: There is no such place in the list.
reason.warranty_months_invalid: Warranty is a number of months from 0 to 600.
reason.product_not_on_review: The card is no longer on review. Refresh the page.
reason.review_reason_required: Give a reason: a general comment or a note on a field.
reason.review_issues_invalid: Check the notes: a field from the list and text up to 500 characters.
reason.review_reason_too_long: The comment is too long: 2000 characters at most.
reason.company_match_confirmation_required: An organization with the same number exists. Confirm whether it is the same company.
reason.company_inn_taken: An organization with this tax ID exists. If it is a different company, reject the application.
reason.candidate_agreement_required: The candidate has not agreed the contract yet. Give a reason to approve without agreement.
reason.partner_suspended: The partner is suspended. Lift the suspension in the partner card.
reason.inn_too_long: The tax ID in the application is longer than 20 characters. Reject it or ask to re-apply.
reason.contract_render_failed: Could not build the contract. Nothing was saved, try again later.
reason.company_mismatch: The application is already linked to another organization. Refresh the list.

items.search: Search by name, article and drawing

empty.title: No items
empty.text: Items appear once they are added to the catalogue. Add the first one.
empty.filtered: Nothing found for these conditions. Change the search or filter.

items.noDocs: No documents. Add a certificate, passport or manual.

form.name: Name
form.kindHint: “From stock” or “to order” is decided by ERP from partner offers.
addSteps: The item appears in the catalogue as a draft.
It can be chosen in costing and have files linked.
editSteps: Changes are saved in the item card.
New costings use the updated unit and VAT.
Quotes already sent do not change.
form.mxikHint: A word or code finds it in the classifier; or type the 17 digits
form.mxikDown: The classifier does not answer — type the code by hand
form.warrantyMonthsHintNone: Empty — no company default is set

offers.leadValue: from stock {{stock}} d, to order {{order}} d

form.title: Offer: {{name}}
form.noPrice: You neither see nor change the partner price: it is open to supply and the director.
form.quotaHint: How many units the partner will ship at this price.
steps: The offer terms are saved for the partner and the item.
New costings use the updated lead time and quota.
The client price is not recalculated.

empty.title: No partners
empty.text: Add a partner or upload their price list.

brigades.showInactive: Show those who no longer work

empty.title: No crews
empty.text: Crews and performers are needed to cost a service: rate and days. Add the first one.

form.name: Name
form.noRate: You neither see nor change the crew rate: it is open to the chief engineer, supply and the director.
addSteps: The crew appears in the list.
The chief engineer picks it when costing a service.
The client does not see the rate.
editSteps: Changes are saved in the list.
Services already costed do not change.
The client does not see the rate.

requests.hintDecide: Approving links a created category to the request; refusing needs a reason. New categories are created in Settings · Company.

empty.title: No requests
empty.text: Whoever manages the catalogue submits a request when no suitable category exists.

form.title: Request a new category
form.name: Category name
form.whyHint: Briefly: which items will go there.
steps: The request goes to the director in “Category requests”.
The director creates the category and links it, or refuses with a reason.
You get a notification about the decision.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.hint: Rates to UZS: automatically from the central bank, or entered by hand for a date. Quotes use the latest rate not older than the limit set in company settings.

form.title: Enter the USD rate for a date
steps: The rate for the date replaces the central bank or a previous manual one.
The previous value stays in the log.
The central bank auto-load will not overwrite a manual rate.

hs.title: HS codes
hs.hint: Goods classifier. A code taken out of use is not deleted, it is closed with a “valid until” date.

empty.title: No codes
empty.text: HS codes are used in item cards and quotes.

form.codeHint: 2, 4, 6, 8 or 10 digits. The code cannot be changed after adding.
form.name: Description
form.untilHint: Empty — no end. A past date closes the code.
addSteps: The code appears in the list.
It can be put in item cards.
The parent entry is found by the code prefix.
editSteps: Changes are saved in the list.
Items with this code do not change.
A closed code stays in old documents.

brands.title: Manufacturers
brands.hint: Brands chosen in the item card. A manufacturer is not deleted — it is removed from the choice.
brands.showInactive: Show those removed from the choice

empty.title: No manufacturers
empty.text: A manufacturer is chosen in the item card. Add the first one.

form.name: Name
addSteps: The manufacturer appears in the list.
It can be chosen in the item card.
editSteps: Changes are saved in the list.
Items with this manufacturer do not change.
One removed from the choice stays in old cards.

docs.subtitle: Documents of items and requests: certificates, passports, manuals, drawings.
docs.search: Search by name, file and item

empty.title: No files
empty.text: Upload a specification, drawing, certificate or procedure and link it to an item or a request.
empty.filtered: No files for these conditions. Change the search or filter.

docs.chatLater: Send to the client in chat: will appear together with the “Chats” section. For now download the file and send it by hand.
docs.noPreview: This format cannot be previewed — download the file.

gone.title: The file is not in the list
gone.text: It was deleted or does not match the filter.

docs.deleteText: The file disappears from technical files; it can only come back by uploading again.
deleteSteps: The file is removed from storage.
Its links to the item and request are removed.
Copies already downloaded stay with those who downloaded them.

form.title: Upload file
form.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG, Word or Excel, up to 20 MB.
form.name: Name
form.linkHint: At least one link is needed: an item or a request.
steps: The file is saved in the protected storage.
It appears on the item and the request it is linked to.
The “Visible to client” mark is saved; the client portal will show it later.
form.clientVisibleHint: A mark for the client portal; showing it is enabled later.

review.note: A partner sent this file from the cabinet. Clients cannot see it until you approve it.

steps: The partner appears in the list and in price list upload.
They have no login: you keep the card.
supplierForm.name: Name
supplierForm.regHint: For a foreign company instead of TIN

cabinetAccess.title: Cabinet access
cabinetAccess.closed: Cabinet closed: the partner cannot sign in.
cabinetAccess.notOpened: The cabinet has not been opened for this partner yet. Add a contact and invite them: a sign-in code is sent by e-mail.

verify.found: CRM client “{{name}}”, TIN {{inn}}, was linked by a matching TIN.
verify.question: Is it the same company? Until you answer, the partner's requests are kept here and do not go to that client.
verify.readOnly: A colleague who can manage partners confirms.

hint.held: Held after a client handoff: check the tax ID in the partner's card and on the CRM client, then press “Invite again”. No link was created, the partner's requests are kept here.
hint.unverified: The link was created by a client handoff from CRM by a matching TIN. The partner's requests are kept here until you confirm it is the same company.
hint.conflict: CRM already has a client with these details, but it is linked to another company. Nothing was changed. Check the tax ID or registration number in the partner's card and on the CRM client, fix the wrong one and invite the partner again.

my_products.label: My products
my_products.hint: The partner fills in cards and prices of their own products; we publish after review.

catalog_requests.label: Catalog and requests
catalog_requests.hint: The catalog is the same as clients see: published products and prices, no partners.

kind.label: Partner type
kind.hint: A label for lists and reports; it does not affect rights.

cabinetAccess.noContacts: No contacts yet. Add the person who will get the invitation: the cabinet is entered by e-mail only.

contact.name: Full name
contact.canAct: Can create requests and upload files
contact.canActNamed: Can create requests and upload files: {{name}}

cabinetAccess.inviteSent: The e-mail with the sign-in code has been sent.
cabinetAccess.readOnly: Only staff allowed to manage partners can invite and change rights.

contactForm.emailHint: The sign-in code is sent to this address.
contactForm.languageHint: The invitation e-mail is sent in this language.
steps: The contact appears on the partner card
The invitation is sent by the separate Invite button
contactForm.canAct: Can create requests and upload files

suspendForm.title: Suspend cabinet access
suspendForm.text: The partner cannot sign in until you invite them again.
steps: Sign-in is closed for all contacts of the company
Open sessions of the partner end on the next action
Access is restored with the Invite button

offerCreate.title: Partner price: {{name}}
steps: The price appears for the partner and on the item card.
New calculations can use it.
offerCreate.leadHint: As in the price list, e.g. “30 days”

fields.name: name
fields.conformity_doc: a valid conformity document with a number

noAccess.title: Price list upload is not available

modeHint.ai: AI suggests rows — check the report

import.validHint: For the whole file; file columns win
import.aiNote: AI read the rows. Compare them with the file before “Apply”.
import.unpublishable: Items missing data for publishing: {{count}}. Complete them on the card.
import.proposalsNote: The price list does not change others’ or published cards — decide on the item card.

codes.HS_CODE_TOO_LONG: HS code longer than 10 digits — not saved: {{value}}
codes.HS_CODE_NOT_IN_CLASSIFIER: HS code not in the classifier: {{value}}

fileErrors.IMPORT_FAILED: The file was not uploaded. Check it and try again.
fileErrors.NAME_COLUMN_NOT_FOUND: The file has no “Name” column. Use the template.
fileErrors.AI_EXTRACT_FAILED: AI could not read the file. Try another file or the template.
fileErrors.AI_EXTRACT_EMPTY: AI found no item rows in the file.
fileErrors.ROWS_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The check is out of date. Press “Check” again.
fileErrors.AI_JOB_FAILED: AI could not read the file. Try again later.

photos.title: Photos
photos.hint: Best: a square from 900 px on a light background. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
photos.empty: No photos. Add the first one — it becomes the main photo.
photos.limit: Limit reached: {{max}} photos. Delete one first.
deleteSteps: The file is removed from storage.
If it is the main photo, the next one becomes main.
The photo can only be restored by uploading it again.

cardDocs.title: Documents
cardDocs.empty: No documents. Add a certificate, passport or manual.
addSteps: The file is saved in the protected storage.
It appears on the item card and in “Technical documents”.
The “Visible to client” mark is saved; the client portal will show it later.
editSteps: The changes are saved in the document.
The file itself does not change.

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.text: Partner cards and changes appear here once they are sent for review.

review.title: Card review
review.changesNote: The partner proposed changes to a published card: accept or reject each one.
review.published: The card is published, the partner will get an email.
review.returned: The card is returned, the partner will get an email with the reasons.

form.title: Return the card to the partner
form.reasonHint: At least one reason is needed: a comment or a note on a field.
steps: The card gets the status “Returned”
The partner sees the reasons in “My products” and gets an email
The partner fixes the card and sends it for review again

partnerPrice.label: Product prices in the catalog
partnerPrice.hint: How clients see prices of this partner’s products

partnerApplications.title: Partner Candidate Applications Queue
partnerApplications.matchHint: An organization with the same TIN was found in ERP
partnerApplications.matchQuestion: Organization “{{name}}” found. Is it the same company?
partnerApplications.matchInnTaken: This tax ID is already taken. If it is a different company, reject the application with a reason.

sendContractModal.title: Sending contract draft: {{name}}
sendContractModal.hint: Specify the contract number (if assigned) and record that the draft was sent to the candidate.
steps: Application status will change to “Contract sent”
The candidate will receive the partner contract draft
The candidate contact will receive an email with cabinet sign-in

approveModal.title: Approve application and open cabinet: {{name}}
approveModal.hint: Confirm signing of the partner contract. Upon approval, the company gains partner cabinet access, the contact is invited, and the counterparty is linked with CRM.
approveModal.hintOverride: The candidate has not agreed the contract yet. You can approve only with a reason, recorded in the log.
approveModal.overridePlaceholder: e.g.: the contract was signed on paper
steps: “Partner” relationship will be activated with “My products” and “Catalog & orders” modules
Contract number and date will be recorded in partner profile
Contact person will receive invitation code
Counterparty will be synced with CRM

rejectModal.title: Reject application: {{name}}
rejectModal.hint: Specify the rejection reason. It will be recorded in audit logs and sent to the applicant.
rejectModal.reasonPlaceholder: e.g.: irrelevant product categories / missing required documents
